instruction: Add a bar along the window
order: plan > checks > numbers > image > images > qa > done
summary: Add a bar with stools running along the storefront window wall in the main dining room.
changes: layout: Storefront window wall in the main dining room | {"lengthFt":20,"seats":10} | seating,plumbing-fixture,alcohol
flags: A new bar sink and drain need a connection to existing plumbing. The city must approve it, and it may need a floor cut in the slab.
The city and the TABC (Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission) must approve alcohol service, including the bar layout and the seat count.
A bar in front of the storefront must keep the entry doors and the exit path clear. Check this with the fire marshal.
checks: restrooms: needs-professional $5,000-25,000 (not counted) [IPC 403.1; ADA 2010 Standards; 28 CFR 36.403]
viewPrompt: Add a long freestanding bar counter running parallel to the storefront glazing, a few feet in from the glass. Give it a solid front panel in dark wood, a butcher-block or stone top, and a footrail. Put a row of bar stools on the window side so guests face the street. Leave the walls, glazing, ceiling, floor and doors as they are.
